basic_details.job_title: Andhra University Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for the fellowship is 35 years on the date of submission of application; age will be calculated by taking the date of closure of the respective call.

qualification.details: The PDF applicant should be an Indian Citizen. | The PDF applicant must have obtained a PhD degree as per UGC norms from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. The applicant should have completed PhD within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of application to the institution and must be a Ph.D awardee from other Universities or institutes of national importance.

salary_details.post doctoral fellow: Fellowship: Rs. 80,000/- (per Month) + 16% HRA as applicable. Contingency: Rs. 10,000/- per annum.
salary_details.details: There is no provision to recruit research personnel under the scheme. Contingency expenditure will be reimbursed subject to submission of bills and approval.

selection_process: The selection process includes shortlisting of eligible candidates by a committee based on merits and the proposal submitted
followed by an interview and research proposal presentation before the selection committee.
how_to_apply: Prepare your complete bio-data, copies of all certificates, and a brief abstract of the proposed research work.
Ensure you meet all eligibility criteria including the PhD requirement within the past 5 years.
Send a soft copy of your application and documents by e-mail to frondesk [email protected].
Send hard copies of your application and documents through post or courier.
Address the application to the REGISTRAR, ANDHRA UNIVERSITY, Visakhapatnam, AP, 530 003.
Submit the application on or before 24 October 2026, 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: The Post Doctoral Fellowship is a full-time, non-transferable, temporary position only tenable in Andhra University. Fellows must not receive any other fellowship or salary from any Government or Non-Government source during the tenure. Applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered; temporary researchers must relinquish current roles on lien if selected. The initial tenure is one year, extendible for one more year (total 2 years) based on performance. IP rights out of research work done during this term will be in the name of Andhra University and the researcher/co-authors. Candidates wishing to discontinue must provide two months notice and complete handing over formalities. No travel allowance, DA, or other expenses shall be paid to candidates attending the interview. Preference will be given to applicants with active industry linkages and research proposals directed towards industry-specific problems.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Andhra University Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Andhra University to appoint 10 Centenary Post Doctoral Fellows across various colleges and departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 Post Doctoral Fellow positions available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 24 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must have obtained a PhD degree as per UGC norms in the relevant discipline with first class in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout, completed within the past 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as of the date of submission of application, with a 5-year relaxation for SC, ST, LBC, Physically Challenged, and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the fellowship?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply offline by sending hard copies via post/courier and a copy via email to the REGISTRAR, ANDHRA UNIVERSITY, Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted by a committee based on merits and the proposal submitted, followed by an interview and research proposal presentation.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Selected fellows receive a fellowship of Rs. 80,000/- per month plus 16% HRA, along with a contingency grant of Rs. 10,000/- per annum.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary full-time assignment for an initial period of one year, extendible for one more year based on performance.
